description: Great Lakes Shoreviewer is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Superior Watershed Partnership & Land Trust; Applied Ecological Services; 906 Technologies. The Great Lakes Shoreviewer is a risk assessment and climate adaptation planning tool. It provides oblique-angle color photography plus multiple layers of additional analysis for prioritized sections of Great Lakes coastline in Michigan (Lake Superior, Lake Michigan, and Lake Huron). Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Erosion and Shoreline Recession, Flooding – Coastal. Assets: Natural Areas and Wildlife, Property. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
